    Critical algebras, without tilting #

    Let D be a directed algebra in which indecomposable projectives are good, with unbounded indecomposables, such that the indecomposables killed by any e_i are rigid and bounded. Then the Euler form is critical, and at a source or sink x where the radical vector is 1 there is a brick V with V(x) = 0 and at least two independent extensions with the simple at x.
